title: polytypo locale-resolution fixtures
description: Conformance cases for spec/rules/locale-resolution.md. Kept separate from spec/schema/fixtures.schema.json because a resolution case has no rule, no mode and no text — it maps a requested tag to a resolved locale or to an error code.

tag.description: The tag as passed by the caller, verbatim — including any casing or separator the resolver is expected to accept or reject.

tagAbsent.description: The caller supplied no locale at all, or a null one — the case spec/rules/locale-resolution.md §3.1 requires to throw. A closed flag rather than a widened `tag` type, so every runtime reads one intent instead of reinterpreting null, undefined and missing keys in its own way.

resolves.description: Canonical locale the tag must resolve to.

throws.description: Resolution never falls back to English; an unresolvable tag throws.
